Effect of active Danshen components or preparations on cytochrome P450 enzymes and role in drug-drug interaction
LI Yun, CHEN Xiao-ping\* (Institute of Clinical Pharmacology, Central South University, Changsha 410078)Abstract: Danshen (Salvia miltiorrhiza), a traditional Chinese herbal medicine, is clinically used for the adjuvant therapy of cardiovascular diseases. The active ingredients of Danshen are complicated, and some of them play signifi - cant roles in the impact of cytochrome P450 isozyme activity in the liver and may be relevant to potential herb-drug interactions. It is meaningful to discuss the effect of Danshen on P450 isozyme activity and the mechanism of herbdrug interactions when Danshen is used with other agents in clinical practice.Key words: Salvia miltiorrhiza monomer; Salvia miltiorrhiza preparation; cytochrome P450 isozyme; drug transporter; nuclear receptor; drug-drug interaction丹参是我国重要的传统医疗的草本植物，临床上广泛用于心脑血管疾病的辅助治疗。目前已发现丹参水溶性单体和脂溶性单体各 40 余种，水溶性单体如丹参素、丹酚酸

有重要的意义。
Effect of active Danshen components or preparations on cytochrome P450 enzymes and role in drug-drug interaction
LI Yun, CHEN Xiao-ping\* (Institute of Clinical Pharmacology, Central South University, Changsha 410078)Abstract: Danshen (Salvia miltiorrhiza), a traditional Chinese herbal medicine, is clinically used for the adjuvant therapy of cardiovascular diseases. The active ingredients of Danshen are complicated, and some of them play signifi - cant roles in the impact of cytochrome P450 isozyme activity in the liver and may be relevant to potential herb-drug interactions. It is meaningful to discuss the effect of Danshen on P450 isozyme activity and the mechanism of herbdrug interactions when Danshen is used with other agents in clinical practice.Key words: Salvia miltiorrhiza monomer; Salvia miltiorrhiza preparation; cytochrome P450 isozyme; drug transporter; nuclear receptor; drug-drug interaction丹参是我国重要的传统医疗的草本植物，临床上广泛用于心脑血管疾病的辅助治疗。目前已发现丹参水溶性单体和脂溶性单体各 40 余种，水溶性单体如丹参素、丹酚酸、原儿茶酚酸等丹酚酸类，多具有抗氧化和细胞保护等作用；脂溶性活性成分如丹参酮、隐丹参酮等，多具有改善血液循环、抗炎和抗菌等作用。临床上应用的丹参制剂如丹参滴丸、复方丹参片等是由多种丹参活性成分制备而成。丹参由于其活性成分复杂，制剂种类繁多，且其多种单体和制剂可影响肝脏药物代谢酶的活性，临床上可能出现药物相互作用，影响合用药物的疗效和不良反应的发生。本文主要从细胞色素 P450 酶（CYP450）出发，对近年来有关丹参活性成分或制剂对CYP450影响的研究进行综述。
